types.name: Runbook
types.description: A documented procedure for diagnosing and resolving operational issues or incidents

types.name: StreamingProtocol
types.description: A server-sent events or similar real-time streaming mechanism for delivering responses

types.name: CitationTag
types.description: A stable identifier assigned to retrieved chunks for grounding and verification of LLM answers

types.name: GoldenSet
types.description: A fixed, versioned collection of questions with reference answers used for regression testing

types.name: Conversation
types.description: A multi-turn dialogue between user and system with maintained context and entity state

types.name: PermissionGroup
types.description: A security group or role that controls access to documents, chunks, or knowledge graph facts

types.name: DataRetentionPolicy
types.description: A rule governing how long different data types are stored and when they are deleted

types.name: Tenant
types.description: An isolated customer or organizational unit in a multi-tenant system
